role: Source-bound tooth-pair and direction presentation; JavaScript adapters remain executable authority.

camera.anchorMeaning: Ideal pitch-region observation target, not a solved contact point.

toothPhase.measurementMethod: Fourier phase at verified tooth count in actual world-transformed GLB sections; phase unwrapped along the herringbone axial bands.
toothPhase.binding: Original source vertices, stable tooth index and middle-band radial/axial mask; planet end bands excluded.
toothPhase.pairSelection: Constant integer tooth-pair sum derived from the inherited sun, orbit and absolute planet phase; neighboring-pair crossfade is an explanatory convention.

direction.policy: Short projected source-plane arcs; derive signs from the same mechanical clock, distinguish spin from orbit, hide near zero speed, and respect reversal and actual camera projection.

identityPolicy: Retain the original pair, source phase, scale, occurrence count and mechanical ownership; cues add no source component or constraint.
motionPolicy: All v2 mechanical poses and v3 camera/explosion/chapter times remain unchanged; presentation cues consume the existing common clock.
appearancePolicy: White fine-line base, limited pale tooth accents and concise direction marks; respect color toggle, actual visibility and current observation state.

output.status: Local capture, export, full decode, native loop and encoded-detail review completed; see output/delivery-review.json for evidence and limits.

validation.scope: Source-bound phase/direction presentation, inherited source/mechanical invariants, actual browser framing and encoded-media delivery; no new contact or force validation.
validation.finalization: README and this plan's delivery metadata were finalized after capture. Runtime, source, camera, timeline and audio inputs remain unchanged; the capture manifest preserves its historical plan hash.

limitations: Source-derived phase and tooth pairing are explanatory cues, not a solved loaded tooth-flank contact.
Tessellated section measurements do not recover exact CAD gear parameters.
The retained CAD implies reverse 31.5:1; the upstream 34:1 claim remains unresolved.
Inherited ideal kinematics and crossed-roller assumptions remain; no new force, backlash, deformation or collision solver.
